role: Bounded prerequisite matrix covering both new same-flux private-error supports and changed-geometry readiness
question: Are there previously untested short same-first-flux red-X error supports on the frozen L=2 graph with an affordable selected-first exact-mass screen, and is paper L=3 ready for a matched physical-law comparison under the existing state/instrument pins?
source_basis: R6AF remediated IID red-X and public-charge interface
J7L exhaustive twelve length-six trivial cycles and frozen topology-edge identity
J7M selected complete first record and base error
J8B exact same-law result for the thirteen previously tested errors under four first records and two actions
J6L/J6M paper L=2 periodic operator and ideal-orbit pins

fork_classification.new_error_support: Enumerate every graph-simple length-four and length-eight cycle, including trivial and nontrivial homology, then toggle the same base error. This is a reversible same-channel L=2 diagnostic, not a human ranking of support classes.
fork_classification.changed_geometry: Inspect the source-normalized L=3 graph size and pin availability only. The L=2 compact orbit and sequential instrument do not transfer automatically, so no L=3 physical law is computed or assumed.
fork_classification.dependency: Same-flux topology and first-record structural cost gate any complete second-law or logical-risk test. A new geometry requires its own source-checked state and instrument before a matched comparison.

frozen_model: The physical channel remains R6AF paper-normalized periodic D4 IID red-X with p_Z=0 and a private physical error. At L=2 the exact J6L/J6M orbit and first full-binary record are retained; the base error is [0,4,3] and the selected first public charge is all zero. Cycle toggles change only private red-X support, never the fixed public first record or a relation-free action. L=3 is a topology/readiness count only, not a new orbit, instrument, error sample or result.

matrix.design: Exhaustively enumerate unique simple edge cycles at lengths four and eight on the pinned L=2 source lattice; classify each loop's winding and triviality, toggle the base error, verify common 24-bit first flux, and audit first eligible-star variable count and deterministic-minus conflict. Sum the exact selected all-plus first-projector term cost over every nonconflicted candidate. Evaluate every exact first mass only if the whole matrix fits the predeclared site and term caps; otherwise release topology/cost only, without selecting a favorable subset. Separately construct only the L=3 source graph and record its vertices and red-edge count, explicitly testing whether L=3 state/instrument pins exist.
matrix.independent_unit: A unique graph-simple cycle/error support at frozen L=2; no stochastic sample, paired risk or uncertainty interval.
matrix.integrity: Pin inputs/runner before and after; replay exactly the twelve J7L length-six cycles and all 36 red-edge identities; verify every toggled error has the same complete first flux; fail closed on cycle cap, topology, homology, site, mass, CPU or pin mismatch. L=3 graph counts are not physical-law validation.

acceptance: All length-four and length-eight simple-cycle support classes enumerated and classified, with exact J7L length-six replay and same-flux checks
Whole-matrix exact selected-first masses evaluated only if the prospective 65,536-term and ten-variable-site gate passes; otherwise cost-only result labels mass unresolved
L=3 graph size and missing independent state/instrument provenance recorded without fabricating an L=3 public law
No complete second law, full-IID information, unconditional logical risk, noisy schedule or threshold claim

outcomes.affordable_positive_new_support: Preserve all positive supports and preregister a separate matched second-public-law discriminator over every affordable class; do not pick a favorable candidate post hoc.
outcomes.cost_censored: Record full structural cost and jointly revise the bounded design before any exact mass or second law; no support-prior or full-IID inference.
outcomes.geometry_unready: Keep L=3 behind new state/operator and public-instrument derivation; this does not block independent L=2 support work.
outcomes.no_new_support: The tested shortest new cycle lengths do not expand the same-flux support; a different explicitly registered error/geometry design would be needed.

stop_rule: Stop after the fixed length-four/eight L=2 cycle classes, length-six replay and L=3 graph readiness count, or earlier on an integrity/cap failure. No adaptive error selection, L=3 state construction, second law, full-IID posterior or logical-risk scoring.
